purpose: Limited 3D numerical transport diagnostic data development; not convergence or laboratory validation

engineering_gates.identity: Only dp changes; record actual geometry discretization and native counts. No changes to physical fill, geometry commands, forcing or solver physics.
engineering_gates.execution: both full6second successful native runs with strictly increasing times and explicit excluded-particle records
engineering_gates.height_comparison: each H1-H4 bridge-to-fine RMSE <=0.0275m (5% of nominal0.55m initialwaterdepth), evaluated over actual common bracketedtime grid with no retiming
engineering_gates.data_integrity: no unlabelled identity loss; all raw native fields and validity semantics retained; decoded coverage and spatial identity checks required before bundle acceptance

auxiliary_only: P1-P8 pressurepeak/integral/timing errors; no pressurequalification from surfacepass
reference-to-experiment differences and absent sourceuncertainty kept visible
tolerance_origin: Internal engineering tolerance chosen before comparison to support limited diagnostic data; not asserted as source sensor uncertainty. Passing does not prove gridconvergence or materialtrajectorytruth.
failure_policy: Do not promote bridge or launch its physicalchildren on failedgates. Analyze specificdifference and remainingbudget; use justifiedalternative without changingthreshold fromcurves.
counting: samephysicalmother atdifferentdp is reference-only and is never an additionalM4condition
